dedupe_keys.name: city2graph geospatial graphs from buildings streets and transit feeds for network analysis and gnns

description: City2Graph is a Python library that turns buildings, streets, public transport feeds, origin-destination matrices, zones and points of interest into spatial and heterogeneous graphs, bridging GeoPandas, NetworkX and PyTorch Geometric. The README lists morphology graphs from OpenStreetMap and Overture Maps; GTFS and GBFS shared-mobility feeds loaded into DuckDB, with GTFS aggregated into stop-to-stop transit graphs; flow graphs from migration, bike-sharing and pedestrian counts; proximity and contiguity graphs; metapaths; and round-trip conversion to graph neural network tensors. It supports Python 3.12 to 3.14 and installs with pip. Coverage: any city with open data. Format and access: open-source package with documentation. Licence and cost: BSD 3-Clause, free. Caveats: a recent research library whose interfaces may change. It supports network flow studies and learning-based models of urban transport networks. It relates to OSMnx, OpenStreetMap, peartree and the GTFS specification in the catalogue.
